    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    bike_patches = image_patch.find("bike")
    
    # Sort the patches by the x-coordinate of the left edge
    bike_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: patch.left)
    
    # The patch with the smallest left edge is the one that appears first from left to right
    front_bike_patch = bike_patches[0]
    
    # Use the llm_query function to answer the query
    answer = front_bike_patch.llm_query(query, long_answer=False)
    
    return answer
